issues.on_page: Charges for services 1,059,117 (Water and Sewer enterprise funds)
issues.issue: Under the user rule of 2026-10-28, utility fund sales and charges go in category Utility Charges, not charges for services/fees.
Mostly rental income (detail line uses detail_category rentals); the receipt category could be Rentals under the 2026-10-28 rule. The label mixes rental and fees.
This is a business-type cost-type line and has no function: "utilities" field, unlike the other cost-type lines.

Lines are taken from the governmental and business-type columns separately, not from the Total column. The pairs do add up to the printed totals (assets 22,241,597; liabilities 7,114,531; net position 15,127,066).
